source: NOAA Office of Coast Survey, ENC Direct to GIS, Harbor and Coastal scale land areas (LNDARE), clipped to the North Carolina coast. Harbor LNDARE is used where it exists; Coastal LNDARE fills remaining shoreline (including Cape Hatteras) so the fill follows the chart. Derived from official NOAA ENC cells but not certified for navigation. Public domain (CC0). https://encdirect.noaa.gov/
